Story.title: We know Da Nang, and we know buyers
Story.body: We do not chase listing counts. Every property is visited in person, checked for legal status and described exactly as it is — so you never waste a trip on a home that was never right.

WhyChoose.title: Three things we do differently
WhyChoose.item1Body: Nothing goes on this site until we have stood in the room and taken the photographs ourselves.
WhyChoose.item2Body: Title deed, the foreign-ownership quota and any outstanding mortgage — verified before we introduce a property.
WhyChoose.item3Body: Vietnamese, English, Chinese and Korean — talk to us in whichever you are most comfortable with.
